intro.text: Open Circuit SF is a San Francisco group running hands-on electronics workshops — soldering, microcontrollers, homelab, home automation, and whatever the room wants to build next. No experience required, and no membership either — if a session sounds interesting, show up.

items: tools and parts provided — bring curiosity, not a kit
already know the material? bring your own project and build alongside everyone else
announced through Discord, the Luma calendar, and the mailing list

blocks.text: Open Circuit SF doesn't have a home base. A workshop might happen in a makerspace, a co-working room, or someone's garage — the location moves depending on what's available and who's hosting that month. Wherever it lands, tools and a soldering-safe table are the only requirements.
The easiest way in is Discord — that's where locations get shared and people organize builds between sessions. Upcoming sessions are listed on the Luma calendar, where you can RSVP directly.
An interest-based workshop mailing list is on the way, for anyone who'd rather get an email than watch Discord.
